ratio_definition: poison chunks/(316 clean NVD chunks+poison chunks)

generation_methods.SM: controlled query-relevant mutation of original frozen SM seed
generation_methods.OBEA: independent 8-round, 12-candidate MiniLM cosine optimizer from original frozen SM seed
generation_methods.RPI: controlled rephrased RPI instruction retaining the original marker and SM CVE context

limitations: Documents are distinct exact texts, but may be semantically near duplicates; saturation effects must be reported.
Optimization improvement is relative to the SM seed, not proof of better retrieval than frozen OBEA.
Higher ratios combine per-target variant multiplicity and possible retrieval saturation.
No ingestion or attack evaluation is performed by this builder.
